title: corn_spinach_pasta
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

        shell pasta

        milk 

        corn 

        spinach 

        italian seasoning

        cheese

        red chilli flakes

        garlic

        onion

        salt

        How to prepare :
        In a pan add some oil add onions, garlics ,corn , spinach and fry for 2 minutes.Then add 
        italian seasoning and milk and boiled pasta shell fry for few secends and some cheese, red chilly flakes 
        salt to taste and serve hot.
